verses.1: Once again, once again… The Shulamit people will be judged by what they do in Shulamit. Just as the campers are judged based on their actions.
verses.2: How beautiful your shoes are! Your feet are covered with beautiful shoes, made by the hands of a true craftsman.
verses.3: Your belly is full of worms; it’s filled with the remains of grains. It’s a mess of filth and decay.
verses.4: Two days apart, like two peaks in the mountains.
verses.5: Your nose is like the height of a tower; your eyes are filled with praise. As you gaze upon the gate of the great ones, your nose is like the height of a tower. It gazes at the face of the beloved one.
verses.6: Your head is like a tower, and your door is like the gate of the king of Asur in Barathim.
verses.7: What is beautiful and what is undesirable in love among those who are separated from each other?
verses.8: This is your fate: you will be like Tamar, and your body will become like that of a beast.
verses.9: I said, “I will climb up to the top of the mountain, and there I will be like the flowers that are blooming in full bloom. The scent from your hair will be like that of blooming flowers.”
verses.10: And wait for the good times to come to my father, when the lips of the old people will be filled with joy.
verses.11: I am yours, my Father, and you are mine.
verses.12: Oh my father, the field has been plowed, and the crops have been harvested.
verses.13: Let’s go to the vineyards. It seems that when the grapes bloom, the buds open up. There, I will give you my daughters in marriage.
verses.14: The gods gave us scent, and on our doors, there were all kinds of new and old decorations. My dear, I’ve prepared everything for you.
